items.t: Ryanair Invests $548 Million in First Engine MRO Facility in Seville
items.sum: RYAAY's $548 million engine MRO investment in Seville strengthens its in-house maintenance capabilities and supports ambitious fleet expansion plans.

items.t: RYAAY Expands Shannon Network With New Toulouse Route for Summer 2027
items.sum: Ryanair expands its Shannon Airport network with a new Toulouse route for Summer 2027, boosting European connectivity and creating more travel opportunities.
The low-cost airline ran its last flight to the holiday destination in October 2026.

items.t: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Copa, LATAM Airlines, Volaris and Ryanair
items.sum: Copa Holdings, LATAM Airlines, Volaris and Ryanair report October 2026 traffic growth, but capacity expansion and load factors reveal diverging performance.

items.t: Is Ryanair Holdings (ISE:RYA) Fully Priced Despite Its Cash Flow Upside?
items.sum: Ryanair Holdings has delivered a powerful 5 year share price gain, yet recent weakness and fresh investment plans raise a sharper question for you as an investor. Is the current price still aligned with the cash the airline can realistically generate over time, or has sentiment moved ahead of those cash flows?
